policies.title: Grenada: Somalia ordinary passports
policies.summary: Grenada's current Embassy nationality schedule directly places Somalia in the prior-arrival visa category.
conditions: Applies to a recognized ordinary Federal Republic of Somalia passport for short visitor travel.
The schedule defines Prior To Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The schedule was revised in April 2024; recheck early if Grenada publishes a later schedule.
Does not classify work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service or special-document travel.

policies.title: Panama: Somalia ordinary passports
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy visitor schedule expressly includes Somalia in its authorized-visa cohort, which requires consular filing before travel.
conditions: Applies to a recognized ordinary Federal Republic of Somalia passport for short visitor travel.
The published authorized-visa procedure requires the applicant to appear in person at the consulate and says approval can take up to 60 business days.
Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver is conditional and does not alter this passport-only baseline.
Does not classify diplomatic, residence, work, transit, invitation or other conditional routes.
